title: LinkedIn Learning and Mohan Babu University partner to offer students industry certifications and expert-led learning.

title: LinkedIn down now? LinkedIn experiences intermittent access issues for some users worldwide.
snippet: LinkedIn experiences intermittent access issues for some users worldwide.

title: Sociable: LinkedIn automates job application process for premium users.
snippet: LinkedIn is gradually rolling out a new Premium Apply Assistant for job seekers, an artificial intelligence-powered system which is designed to make it easier for paid LinkedIn users to apply for the open roles that they're best suited for.

title: LinkedIn begins testing collaborative posts feature with creators and brands.
snippet: Professional networking platform LinkedIn has announced that it is testing a new Collaborative Posts feature that will allow multiple members and LinkedIn Pages to publish content together on the platform.

title: Measure deeper LinkedIn engagement with Saves & Sends in Social BI.
snippet: To give you complete visibility into these engagement signals, Oktopost Technologies Inc. has integrated LinkedIn Saves and Sends directly into Oktopost Social BI.

title: IN PR: Ong joins LinkedIn APAC; Perera's new stint at Metricon.
snippet: LinkedIn has appointed Judy Ong as senior communications manager, APAC, with Ong relocating into the platform's regional communications ranks after nearly four years at Disney.

title: LinkedIn expands Brand Kit to give marketers control over ai-generated content.
snippet: LinkedIn has continued quietly developing its Brand Kit feature inside Campaign Manager, giving marketers a way to set their core brand colors, fonts, and brand voice guidelines that LinkedIn's AI system then uses when generating ads and content automatically.

title: LinkedIn adds collaborative posts.
snippet: LinkedIn announced a collaborative posts feature, which will enable creators to invite other LinkedIn members to be co-creators of in-stream posts.

title: LinkedIn launches Connected Apps, shifting profiles beyond job titles.
snippet: LinkedIn has introduced a new feature called Connected Apps, allowing members to connect workplace tools directly to their LinkedIn profiles.

title: LinkedIn India extends partnership with Mentor Together through INR 1.5 crore grant to upskill 25000 students across Karnataka.
snippet: LinkedIn, the world's largest professional network, has extended its partnership with Mentor Together, a non-profit organisation

title: Linkedin's time spent per user is up 25% year-to-date, the fastest in social, as its 360Brew AI feed takes hold.
snippet: When LinkedIn's data science team pushed the 360Brew feed-ranking model live, Apptopia's user-level panel started picking up a clear acceleration in how much time people spend in the app.

title: LinkedIn courts B2B advertisers with creator-led ad push.
snippet: Additionally, LinkedIn has introduced BrandWorks, a dedicated team focused on brand strategy, content, creative and events for selected advertisers on the platform.

title: LinkedIn adds audience reach breakdown to creator analytics.
snippet: LinkedIn has introduced a new analytics metric that allows creators to see how much of their content reach comes from people within their network compared with those outside it, according to a post by Sam Carrao Clanon, Direcotr od Product, Creator, LinkedIn.

title: LinkedIn adds new post analytics to help creators measure real business impact.
snippet: LinkedIn has rolled out expanded post analytics that give creators a clearer picture of exactly who their content is reaching, splitting impressions into two distinct categories: in-network reach and out-of-network reach.

title: LinkedIn: cybersecurity vs cyberattack | cyber security news(r).
snippet: LinkedIn recently disclosed a security incident involving the exploitation of a vulnerability tied to its cookie-based authentication system.

title: Advancing talent development by capitalizing on e-learning.
snippet: Consolidated Contractors Company (CCC) continues to strengthen its commitment to structured talent development through a new agreement with LinkedIn Learning, providing access to thousands of expert-led digital learning modules across engineering support skills, technology, and professional disciplines.
